sourceRefs.locator: Transcription, English translation of EA 2 §§ 1–3, opening and conclusion. Uncertain political context, widows and orphans, ransoming captives, strangers, younger and older visitors.
Entry Baptême: the baptistery identified in the 1995 excavations beneath the cathedral and its proposed association with Clovis.
Part II, “Bischof Remigius”, first paragraph and n. 1. The episcopate spans Clovis’s reign; the bishop’s own reference to its length in EA 3.

processingNote.de: Der Punkt verortet die heutige Stadt. Ein bestimmtes historisches Gebäude lässt sich damit nicht bestimmen.
processingNote.en: The point locates the modern town. It does not identify any particular historical building.
